{
  "id": "flux-fill-dev",
  "family": "flux-fill-dev",
  "genre": "image",
  "label": "Inpaint",
  "description": "Dual-engine masked region inpainting \u2014 FLUX.1-Fill (dedicated fill arch) or LanPaint on any base model.",
  "source": {
    "type": ""
  },
  "defaults": {
    "inpaint_context_pad": 64,
    "inpaint_detail": "crop+stitch",
    "inpaint_edge_extend": 0,
    "inpaint_target_size": 1024,
    "outpaint_bottom": 0,
    "outpaint_left": 0,
    "outpaint_overlap": 16,
    "outpaint_right": 0,
    "outpaint_top": 0,
    "refine_denoise": 0.4,
    "mode": "replace",
    "steps": 20,
    "cfg": 1.0,
    "guidance": 30.0,
    "sampler": "euler",
    "scheduler": "normal",
    "seed": 42,
    "mask_grow": 8,
    "mask_feather": 8,
    "mask_threshold": 0.0,
    "mask_invert": false
  },
  "engine": "",
  "form": "form_inpaint",
  "has_inference": false,
  "has_rubric": false
}
